samples.gold:
CREATE TABLE carrers (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE profiles (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  created TEXT,
  updated TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE semesters (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE skills (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE skill_levels (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE status_applications_students (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE workdays (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE modalities (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE districts (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE users (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  email TEXT,
  password TEXT,
  reset_token TEXT,
  created TEXT,
  updated TEXT,
  profile_id INTEGER,
  FOREIGN KEY (profile_id) REFERENCES profiles(id)
);

CREATE TABLE students (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  names TEXT,
  last_names TEXT,
  email TEXT,
  phone TEXT,
  district_id INTEGER,
  picture_url TEXT,
  summary TEXT,
  carrer_id INTEGER,
  semester_id INTEGER,
  user_id INTEGER,
  created TEXT,
  updated TEXT,
  FOREIGN KEY (carrer_id) REFERENCES carrers(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (semester_id) REFERENCES semesters(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (district_id) REFERENCES districts(id)
);

CREATE TABLE enterprises (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT,
  ruc TEXT,
  email TEXT,
  phone TEXT,
  website_url TEXT,
  description TEXT,
  address TEXT,
  picture_url TEXT,
  district_id INTEGER,
  sector_id INTEGER,
  size_id INTEGER,
  user_id INTEGER,
  created TEXT,
  updated TEXT,
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (district_id) REFERENCES districts(id)
);

CREATE TABLE applications (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  title TEXT,
  description TEXT,
  benefits TEXT,
  functions TEXT,
  vacancies INTEGER,
  created TEXT,
  published TEXT,
  email_notification INTEGER,
  closed TEXT,
  salarry REAL,
  is_draft INTEGER,
  modalities_id INTEGER,
  semester_id INTEGER,
  district_id INTEGER,
  workday_id INTEGER,
  enterprise_id INTEGER,
  FOREIGN KEY (semester_id) REFERENCES semesters(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (enterprise_id) REFERENCES enterprises(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (modalities_id) REFERENCES modalities(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (district_id) REFERENCES districts(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (workday_id) REFERENCES workdays(id)
);

CREATE TABLE experiences (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT,
  enterprise TEXT,
  description TEXT,
  start_date TEXT,
  end_date TEXT,
  student_id INTEGER,
  FOREIGN KEY (student_id) REFERENCES students(id)
);

CREATE TABLE links (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT,
  url TEXT,
  student_id INTEGER,
  FOREIGN KEY (student_id) REFERENCES students(id)
);

CREATE TABLE logs (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id INTEGER,
  description TEXT,
  created TEXT,
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
);

CREATE TABLE students_skills_skill_levels (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  student_id INTEGER,
  skill_id INTEGER,
  skill_level_id INTEGER,
  FOREIGN KEY (student_id) REFERENCES students(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (skill_id) REFERENCES skills(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (skill_level_id) REFERENCES skill_levels(id)
);

CREATE TABLE applications_skills (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  application_id INTEGER,
  skill_id INTEGER,
  FOREIGN KEY (skill_id) REFERENCES skills(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (application_id) REFERENCES applications(id)
);

CREATE TABLE applications_carrers (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  application_id INTEGER,
  carrer_id INTEGER,
  FOREIGN KEY (carrer_id) REFERENCES carrers(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (application_id) REFERENCES applications(id)
);

CREATE TABLE students_applications_saved (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  created TEXT,
  student_id INTEGER,
  application_id INTEGER,
  FOREIGN KEY (student_id) REFERENCES students(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (application_id) REFERENCES applications(id)
);

CREATE TABLE applications_students (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  application_id INTEGER,
  student_id INTEGER,
  status_applications_student_id INTEGER,
  notes TEXT,
  created TEXT,
  FOREIGN KEY (student_id) REFERENCES students(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (application_id) REFERENCES applications(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (status_applications_student_id) REFERENCES status_applications_students(id)
);

CREATE TABLE applications_students_reviews (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  applications_students_id INTEGER,
  points INTEGER,
  enviroment INTEGER,
  learning INTEGER,
  work_load INTEGER,
  title TEXT,
  comment TEXT,
  created TEXT,
  updated TEXT,
  start TEXT,
  end TEXT,
  anonimous INTEGER,
  FOREIGN KEY (applications_students_id) REFERENCES applications_students(id)
);
